title: Ambassador Program
description: Join the volunteer corps on a mission to spark curiosity, build community, and inspire confidence.

title: Ambassador
Program
hero.pinAlt: The ambassador pin, floating and catching the light
hero.lede: A volunteer corps for people who can't keep a good thing to themselves.

mission.title: Spark curiosity.
mission.alt: Teal cat-eye enamel glowing into ink, with fine teal glitter

mission.title: Build community.
mission.alt: A raised nickel line tracing the swoosh over red enamel

mission.title: Inspire confidence.
mission.alt: Red cat-eye enamel with fine red glitter

you.title: It starts with you.
you.lede: Give a little time. It pays you back three ways.

items.label: As a professional
items.title: Skills that travel.
items.body: Storytelling, facilitation, community building, discovery. Practiced for real, with your name on it.

items.label: As a neighbor
items.title: A say in what gets built.
items.body: You listen to your neighbors, and their problems become the ones The Labs takes on.

items.label: As a person
items.title: Confidence you earn.
items.body: You tell your story, hold a room, and learn more by teaching than you ever did alone.

labs.title: Worth being curious about.
labs.lede: Free. Run by volunteers. Born at DC Public Library in fall 2025. Three habits run all of it.

habits.title: We decide together.
habits.body: Every Build Cycle, participants pick the problems. Everyone gets a vote.

habits.title: We learn by building.
habits.body: Small teams build real things for real problems, and make them last.

habits.title: We pass it on.
habits.body: Everyone teaches what they learn as they go. It's the fastest way to learn it.

ripple.title: One conversation, then it spreads.

rings.title: You
rings.body: You find your story, and the nerve to tell it.

rings.title: Someone you know
rings.body: One conversation, and their next chapter starts.

rings.title: Your community
rings.body: Their Pod picks a problem your neighbors actually have, and builds something that lasts.

rings.title: Everyone
rings.body: Now picture it in every neighborhood. The future gets built either way. This is how everyone gets a hand in it.

ripple.note: America's first lending library started with a dozen neighbors who met to teach each other. The Labs started inside a library.
ripple.videoLabel: A small planet with teal and red glows at the centre of nickel orbits. Swoosh-shaped craft circle it, one on the first orbit, more on each one after, and a pulse of light spreads out past them all.

team.title: Curiosity goes both ways.
team.lede: You'll spark it in other people and follow your own. Every conversation is research: what you hear shapes the problems The Labs takes on, and what you learn becomes how every Labs project grows.

roles.title: Talk to people.
roles.body: One on one, no script. Ask what they're working toward. Then listen.

roles.title: Take the mic.
roles.body: Tell a room about The Labs. You'll practice first, so you won't be winging it.

roles.title: Share your link.
roles.body: It's yours alone. Everyone who joins The Labs through it counts.

roles.title: Bring someone along.
roles.body: Guide a new ambassador through orientation. That's how the corps grows.

title: The button says you're in.
The pin says you passed it on.
path.lede: Small steps, each one marked. By the time you face a room, you'll have done it in practice.

steps.title: Get oriented.
steps.body: A short video, the agreement, a quick quiz. The button is yours.

steps.title: Do the work.
steps.body: [N] new upskillers join through your link. You give one talk to a room.

steps.title: Mentor someone.
steps.body: Bring one new ambassador through orientation. You're a Mentor now, and the pin is yours.

rewards.title: The button
rewards.body: Ten minutes in, it's yours. It's how people spot an ambassador, and how you'll spot each other.
rewards.alt: The ambassador button: the orb mark on ink, ringed by THE UPSKILLING LABS and AMBASSADOR in white

rewards.title: The pin
rewards.body: [N] new upskillers, one talk, one new ambassador. It can't be bought, only passed on.
rewards.alt: The Mentor pin: the orb mark in polished nickel with teal and red cat-eye enamel

goal.title: What we're building, together.
goal.meterLabel: New upskillers adding up toward the goal
goal.note: About two new upskillers a week per ambassador, while the corps keeps growing. That's what Mentors are for. Nobody carries this alone.

quote.text: I came to one workshop for myself. Now the best part is watching someone I brought in find their team.
quote.name: [PLACEHOLDER] Founding ambassador

join.title: Come be an ambassador.
join.lede: Ten minutes to get oriented. Everything after, we'll figure out together.

items.a: No. Being an ambassador is free. So is The Labs: every workshop and Build Cycle.

items.q: How much time does it take?
items.a: About ten minutes to get oriented. After that, mostly conversations you'd have anyway, plus one talk to a room. [PLACEHOLDER: add a typical hours-per-month figure.]

items.q: Do I need to be technical?
items.a: No. You need curiosity about people and a story you're willing to tell. The guide covers the rest.

items.q: What's the difference between the button and the pin?
items.a: The button comes at orientation. It says you're in. The pin is for Mentors: [N] new upskillers through your link, one talk to a room, and one new ambassador brought through orientation. It can't be bought.
Yes, any time. Tell your coordinator. The door stays open.
Your ambassador coordinator. Their contact is in the guide, and they reply within two working days. [PLACEHOLDER: confirm the coordinator's details.]

items.label: What you commit to
items.title: A few conversations. One talk.
items.body: Tell your story, invite people you know, and give one short talk. [PLACEHOLDER: add expected hours per month.]

items.label: Who can join
items.title: Anyone who wants others to find The Labs.
items.body: No tech skills or expertise needed. [PLACEHOLDER: confirm eligibility, e.g. you've been to a workshop or Build Cycle.]

items.title: Ten minutes, then the button.
items.body: Raise your hand, get oriented, and your button is on its way. The guide takes it from there.
